clips.title: The story
paras: Warlocks leave Stormwind City for Ratchet, where Strahad Farsan can teach them to summon felhunters. Beneath the goblin port, his knowledge offers a path into more dangerous demon summoning.

Gakin the Darkbinder sends you from Stormwind to seek help with summoning a felhunter. He guides warlocks in the Slaughtered Lamb, below the Mage Quarter, but the rites call for knowledge beyond what he can offer there. Your journey carries you across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, where another warlock may know the way.

Strahad Farsan lives in the arid hills above Ratchet, the goblin harbor. He is a human warlock and a peer of Gakin's in their secret cabal. From neutral territory, Strahad can work beyond the notice of Alliance magistrates, church inquisitors, and Horde sentries. Warlocks come to him hoping to master demons that drain mana.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is time you learned the felhunter summoning, friend. I do not have the reagents and items necessary to teach you here, so you will have to seek out another, Strahad Farsan, another of our inner circle.
He makes his residence in the goblin port of Ratchet. I will send word ahead of you to inform him of your coming.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend? Ah, of course. Our latest prodigy. The real thing can't live up to the legend, I'm afraid.
No matter, you've come here to learn, not to hear me make jokes to myself.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
